types.name: PullToRefreshProps
types.doc: A scroll container that refreshes when it is dragged down from the top, with a finger or the mouse. The content follows the pull with growing resistance, the indicator stretches into a capsule past the threshold, spins while the refresh runs, confirms, and settles back. A "Refresh" button that appears on keyboard focus does the same without the gesture.

members.name: onRefresh
members.doc: Runs when a pull is released past the threshold. Return a promise: the indicator spins until it settles.

members.name: refreshing
members.doc: Shows the refreshing state from outside, for a refresh that did not start with a pull (a button, a timer).

members.name: threshold
members.doc: Pull distance in pixels at which releasing starts a refresh.

members.name: maxPull
members.doc: The farthest the content can travel, in pixels. Resistance grows toward it.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Turns the gesture off; the content still scrolls.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of the scroll area, as a number of pixels or any CSS length. Defaults to filling its parent.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the scroll region.

members.name: refreshLabel
members.doc: Text of the keyboard refresh button.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the outer element.
